'''"Hyper" Rod''' was a reprogrammed [[protocol droid]] who participated in [[Riot Racing]] at the [[Safa Toma Speedway]] on the [[planet]] [[Serolonis]].<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|hyper-rod|"Hyper" Rod}}</ref><ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/faster-episode-guide|text="Faster" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}}</ref> Rod raced in a modified [[Seven Deuce Blaster]]. While racing on Serolonis's riot racing track, Rod got passed by [[TAY-0]] while in first place. He later took part in the following race, but ultimately lost to [[Tech]].<ref name="Faster" />
